summary: Project inventory source fields: credential, Project and Inventory file (a file, directory or script), with Source variables for script environment; custom scripts from SCM need chmod +x or the sync fails with [Error 13] Permission denied.
questions: Why does my inventory script fail with Error 13 Permission denied?
Can a project inventory source point to a directory?
How do I pass environment variables to an inventory script?
How do I select the inventory file from my project?

answer_card.title: Inventory script Permission denied
answer_card.answer_md: If a custom inventory script from source control fails with `[Error 13] Permission denied`, set the execute bit on the script in the upstream repository (`chmod +x script` and commit), then sync the project and inventory source again.
